anomalies.observed: In the Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block on the top sheet, the TSC_G2_IO2 and TSC_G2_IO4 labels are both connected to the same conductor at the left terminal of R8; C14 is tied to that same node. This places the sampling-capacitor net and the electrode series-resistor net on the same node.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires these to be separate TSC group IO nets: TSC_G2_IO2 is PB5 through R8 to the A2 BTN electrode, while TSC_G2_IO4 is PB7 through C14 to GND. They must not be joined.

evidence.quote: Top sheet, Capacitive Touch Button (TSC): labels "TSC_G2_IO4" and "TSC_G2_IO2" are both on the wire leading to the left terminal of R8.
"TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN"; "TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)"

anomalies.impact: PB5 and PB7 are shorted and the TSC sampling capacitor is connected into the electrode path, which would likely prevent the capacitive touch button from working correctly or cause contention on the MCU pins.

parsed.summary: The drawing shows a connectivity anomaly in the capacitive touch block: TSC_G2_IO2 and TSC_G2_IO4 are merged at the R8/C14 node, contrary to the specified separate electrode and sampling-capacitor nets.
